lines: Buffalo went to Minneapolis and won 23-6 behind James Cook III's 31 carries for 107 yards. Bills are 7-1, the best record in the AFC, and they get the 2-7 Jets as 8.5-point road favourites.
Denver is 7-2 after a 26-21 win at Carolina. San Francisco sits 7-1 and travels to Dallas as SF -3.5 with a 55.5 total, the fattest number on the Week 10 board.
Jacksonville is 6-2 and buried Baltimore 33-10 in Week 9. The Jaguars are laying 10.5 at 1-7 Tennessee next.
Cleveland lost 23-22 in overtime at New Orleans despite Shedeur Sanders going 19/31 for 297 and 2 TD. The 5-4 Browns host Houston as 4.5-point home dogs, total just 39.5.
Houston hung 44 on the winless Chargers, C.J. Stroud 21/35 for 384 and 5 TD. LAC is 0-8 and visits Baltimore on Tuesday 9:15 am Perth.
Chicago is 7-2 after beating Tampa 27-24, and Green Bay put 45 on New England with Jordan Love at 23/29, 372 yards, 3 TD. Packers host Minnesota at GB -4.5.

postgame.what_decided_it: Cincinnati was efficient and clean in Madrid. 7.1 yards per play, 6 of 10 on third down, zero turnovers, 3 of 4 in the red zone. Atlanta ran well at 6.5 a carry but threw for only 162 and took 12 penalties for 88 yards.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 24/29, 271 yards, 3 TD, 0 INT. Nothing wasted.
Tee Higgins: 5 catches for only 32 yards but two touchdowns.
postgame.division_meaning: Pittsburgh sits 6-2 on a four game win streak, Cincinnati 5-2 in the table and winners of three, with the best differential in the division at +48. Cleveland 5-3, Baltimore 4-5 and losers of four.
postgame.the_take: The run game is the quiet part of this. 123 yards on 24 carries at 5.1 a pop meant Burrow never had to force anything. Do that against Pittsburgh and the North shifts.
